declaration: Pine v6 / V3.7 Lite / educational adaptation

formula_lines.text: aHigh := startAsia ? high : (inAsia ? math.max(nz(aHigh, high), high) : aHigh)
aLow := startAsia ? low : (inAsia ? math.min(nz(aLow, low), low) : aLow)
lHigh := startAsia ? na : (validLondonStart ? high : (inLondon and asiaReady ? math.max(nz(lHigh, high), high) : lHigh))
lLow := startAsia ? na : (validLondonStart ? low : (inLondon and asiaReady ? math.min(nz(lLow, low), low) : lLow))
bool measureNow = endLondon and asiaReady and lCount == londonCandles and not na(aHigh) and not na(lHigh)
float amplitude = measureNow ? math.max(aHigh, lHigh) - math.min(aLow, lLow) : na
bool topInAsia = aHigh <= lHigh
bool bottomInAsia = aLow >= lLow
float topBoxHeight = topInAsia ? (aHigh - aLow) : (lHigh - lLow)
float bottomBoxHeight = bottomInAsia ? (aHigh - aLow) : (lHigh - lLow)
float topAnchor = math.min(aHigh, lHigh) - topBoxHeight * topInsetPct / 100.0
float bottomAnchor = math.max(aLow, lLow) + bottomBoxHeight * bottomInsetPct / 100.0
float newTopTarget = topAnchor + nz(amplitude, 0)
float newBottomTarget = bottomAnchor - nz(amplitude, 0)
float highGuideValue = math.max(aHigh, lHigh)
float lowGuideValue = math.min(aLow, lLow)
bool highConfirmed = pairReady and not highAlerted and barstate.isconfirmed and close > globalHigh
bool lowConfirmed = pairReady and not lowAlerted and barstate.isconfirmed and close < globalLow
bool upperZoneNow = direction == 1 and fired and not topZoneHit and bar_index > nz(signalBar, bar_index) and high >= targetTop - topUSD
bool lowerZoneNow = direction == -1 and fired and not bottomZoneHit and bar_index > nz(signalBar, bar_index) and low <= targetBottom + bottomUSD
